svg.title: IFINDIT LAKEHOUSE: storage and processing as the platform foundation
svg.desc: IFINDIT LakeHouse illustration: the data lake and the warehouse appear as two plates side by side, and the processing layer sits above both, linked to each by high-voltage lines. ERP, CSV and API sources plug into the data lake; modelled data from the warehouse feeds a sales-by-region dashboard, and the Data Source Query component runs the SQL query “SELECT region, SUM(amount) FROM sales_2026” on the processing layer. A map below highlights LakeHouse. Auth IAM and LakeHouse are the base from which the PQRS Classifier, Search and Data Catalog derive; ChatGen assistants and Dashboards are built from these three, and Dashboards can also use ChatGen data.
